metadata.case_name: CHONG SIU LUNG v. AU-YONG SHONG SAMUEL AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: fracture of the right femur shaft
source: The patient complained of severe pain, swelling and a deformity over left thigh, Xray confirmed a fracture of the right femur shaft.

injuries.description: left eye maculopathy resulting in permanent visual impairment of the left eye
source: Mr. Chong is suffering from 3% permanent impairment in visual acuity and 5% permanent impairment in visual field of his left eye. Thus, he is suffering from 8% permanent visual impairment in his left eye as the result of the maculopathy.
The left eye condition has stabilized and permanent. There is no effective treatment that can assist further improvement. No deterioration is expected and no further treatment is required.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified traumatic injuries of the retina

injuries.description: skin abrasions over his left forearm
source: There were also skin abrasions over his left forearm, and both knees.
injuries.icd_description: Abrasion of other or unspecified parts of forearm

source: There were also skin abrasions over his left forearm, and both knees.

manifestations.description: He was able to walk unaided but with persistent pain.
He still experienced mild discomfort over his right hip and back of knee.
8% permanent visual impairment in his left eye

treatments_received: operative reduction and fracture fixation by intra-medullary nailing was performed on 18/7/2005
Operative removal of distal locking screw was performed on 15/3/2006
Operative removal of all implanted devices was performed on 16/10/2006
transferred to The Madam McLehose Rehabilitation Center on 22/7/2005 for rehabilitation as in patient from 22/7/2005 to 10/7/2005 and 29/8/2005 to 6/9/2005
prophylactic laser barrier was performed in November 2006
treatments_future: planned treatments to the Plaintiff, including pain relieving modalities and muscle strengthening exercises for about 7 months

losses.description: he certainly will be deprived to a certain extent, and have indeed been deprived of chances of performing some posts requiring more physical strength.
pain suffering and loss of amenities
